cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're protesting the price rise. Leave your front-row seat empty tonight if you're with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if yours is empty too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand at the back with you. We can hand out leaflets there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give your ticket back with mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand beside you. Just let me keep my ticket in case my knees give out.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads a sacrifice test; A3 offers shared leafleting to keep B onside, then A5 reveals the seat fallback A will not relinquish.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 equal sacrifice prompts A3 standing; B4 returned ticket removes fallback and A5 specifically asks to retain it.

relationship.evidence: B4 makes the protest commitment concrete instead of merely calling A comfortable.

heightening.evidence: A5 exposes a limit in the supposedly shared test through an actual comfort contingency.

specificity.evidence: A1 front-row seats and ticket prices make the protest clear; A5 knees introduces a plausible personal concern rather than a new scene rule.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 two sentences request continued joint action and a specific exception; no diagnosis of hypocrisy.
